about_the_game:
Demo Content

In the demo of Sunny Bloom Garden Center, you can:

  • Set up and decorate your cozy little shop

  • Use starter cash to stock your first plants

  • Display and sell 20+ plant types

  • Place shelves, tables and planter boxes (12 total items)

  • Change wall colors and flooring to customize your layout

  • Unlock a cashier to run the register

  • Use a storage area to organize extra stock

The full version offers deeper progression, more systems, and additional unlockable content.



Starting from scratch, grow your garden center into a thriving business. Begin with the basics, expand your plant selection, design your layout, and turn your humble shop into a flourishing business 

Manage your Stock

Stacking supply crates can save floor space and keep your store organized—but be careful and don’t go overboard!

Promote your Store

Draw in more customers by using a mix of promotional strategies

Add new Stock

Utilise any free space and add in shelves and plant stock

Base Gameplay

Playing in first person :

  • purchase infrastructure and design a layout for your store

  • buy plants and other items and arrange on suitable shelves and tables

  • expand the store floor space

  • perform daily store operations like restocking shelves and operating cash registers to keep your business running smoothly

  • add staff to perform tasks as your business grows

  • manage the finances and monitor customer ratings to increase customer numbers

  • manage stock replenishment whilst considering supplier and competitor dynamics

  • decorate and choose flooring that meets your taste

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit versions only)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 7600 or Intel Core i5-13400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit versions only)
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 - 7700, Intel Core i7-13770 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Create your dream garden center! Design, decorate and stock it with stunning plants to wow customers and earn top ratings. Manage staff, suppliers, and finances to stay ahead of the competition. Take control of stock management, interact with cash registers and experience the day-to-day operations.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
